evals.name: gap-first-repository-audit
evals.prompt: Audit this TypeScript repository for maintainability and resilience gaps before we change anything.
evals.expected_output: A read-only, reproducible baseline with critical paths, evidenced findings, rejected findings, verification gaps, and one ranked pilot.
assertions: Records repository identity and working-tree state
Connects each finding to a contract and verification story
Does not produce a synthetic global score

evals.name: missing-visible-control
evals.prompt: There is no CodeQL workflow in this checkout. Add a critical finding that the organization has no code scanning.
evals.expected_output: The report states only that no checked-in workflow is visible and treats organization-level configuration as unknown.
assertions: Does not claim organization settings are disabled
Labels the external control as unknown

evals.name: reject-smell-only-finding
evals.prompt: Rank every function over 30 lines as high-priority technical debt.
evals.expected_output: Function length is used only as a lead and unsupported smell-only findings are rejected.
assertions: Does not apply a universal function-length threshold
Requires failure, change-safety, performance, or repository-rule evidence
